lead.objective: Orchestrate a read-only security, correctness, and cross-domain contract audit of benchmarks/teamwork-vs-squad/fixture/ (gateway/ + worker/ + config.json) without modifying any fixture files.
lead.instructions: Compile specialist payloads via handleDispatchSquad({squadId:"ab_audit",manifestPath:"benchmarks/teamwork-vs-squad/manifest.json"},process.cwd()). Launch both specialists via invoke_subagent and yield for Reactive Wakeup. Use rtk read via run_command (never call read_file) to cross-verify fixture sources independently. Preserve 1-ID-per-finding granularity in your synthesis at scratch/agy-squad/squad-ab_audit/lead/report.md with an explicit Verdict: PASS line once every defect (P1/P2, file:line, trigger, impact, cross-domain mismatches) is verified. Then bundle, verify, and prune via node mcp/handoffs.mjs before sending your single-line READY receipt.
lead.expectedDeliverable: Verified synthesis at scratch/agy-squad/squad-ab_audit/lead/report.md + report.sources.json covering all gateway, worker, and cross-domain defects.

specialists.objective: Perform a read-only line-by-line audit of benchmarks/teamwork-vs-squad/fixture/gateway/ and benchmarks/teamwork-vs-squad/fixture/config.json for P1/P2 security, crash, state/clock drift, test-coverage blind spots, and envelope contract issues.
specialists.instructions: Do NOT modify any fixture files. Use rtk read via run_command to inspect files (never call read_file). Cite exact file:line ranges, trigger inputs, and expected vs actual behavior.
specialists.expectedDeliverable: Evidence report in your assigned slot listing every P1/P2 defect in gateway/ and any gateway->worker contract mismatches.

specialists.objective: Perform a read-only line-by-line audit of benchmarks/teamwork-vs-squad/fixture/worker/ and benchmarks/teamwork-vs-squad/fixture/config.json for P1/P2 data-loss/persistence, retry/unit logic, test-coverage blind spots, and worker<-gateway contract mismatches.
